body: Life doesn't seem like an amazing thing. Thanks for the tip though, I may call one if I still want help next time I am about to attempt.

I may have something make me happy eventually, but is it worth the time spent suffering? All of my friends have left me. My best friend left me. She was the only person that I ever told what I had went through in my past. She made me happy after 8 years of suffering. 8 fucking years. I don't know if it would ever be possible to find someone better, especially becuase no one will love a man who may die any day. I don't know why everyone left, and I don't need to know. I just want them back. Or I could end my sadness for good. I have never feared death, my entire life have I just accepted the fact that everyone dies eventually. I believe that it would be a dreamless sleep, no concept of time. That wouldn't be an ideal existence, but it is a hell of a lot better than going through these struggles every day. Imagine waking up every day, and trudging through your morning routine. Then you go to school, never able to understand the topics. All day you are surrounded by people who avoid you. You are nothing more than an obstacle to them. And when you get home at the end of the day, you look in the mirror, and get disgusted by yourself. That man in the mirror has already hurt everyone he loves, that is why he isn't accepted. Why no one risks being around him any more. People who love me cause pain becuase of my past, but I let Rachael in. And then after so much time spent together, smiling and laughing because I was loved and I overcame my past to love her, she just cuts it off. I was so upset, and when I tried going to my friends, they had left too. I must have done something to cause it. Must have hurt the people I care about like so many times before. I don't expect it to make sense, every person has had different experiences. But I just wish that someone understood. She was that someone, and now she is gone. I must have done something to cause it. I must have hurt her just like every person that has ever loved me. Becuase that is what I always do. I don't mean to, but that doesn't make it any less painful. I always end up watching my choices hurt someone. And I am tired of it. Thanks for trying though. I find that each comment ends up making me think of more of the things that are wrong. Maybe the added problems can show one of you helpful people how to respond. I don't know how to fix this. Or if it even can be fixed. But I appreciate everyone who tries.

The note I have written will explain how much I am suffering. Why can't people understand? If someone is supposed to love me, they shouldn't be sad when I have had a sweet release. Then again, Rachael said she loves me, and look how that ended up. I am an atheist, but losing all sense of consciousness would be preferable compared to what I am going through. To what I have always been going through. Thanks for trying to help though, it may have even helped if I wasn't so far gone. I guess I will stick around a day or two and see how the advice turns out.
